name: Crockett's Canoe Rental
description: Family-run NPS-authorized concessioner at the junction of Hwy 14 and Hwy 27 north, renting canoes, kayaks and rafts with shuttle service, alongside a country store carrying groceries and camping supplies.
alt_names: Crockett's Country Store & Buffalo River Canoe Rental

name: Lost Valley Canoe & Lodging
description: NPS-authorized upper-river concessioner at Ponca with canoe rentals and shuttles, a historic general store, and eight lodging units — three cabins, three yurts and two bunkhouses.

name: Buffalo River Canoes
description: NPS-authorized concessioner with more than thirty years on the Buffalo, based at the corner of Kyles Landing Road and Highway 74 West. Canoes, kayaks and rafts with shuttles, and a river shop open 9 to 5.

name: Rio Buffalo Outfitter
description: NPS-authorized middle-river concessioner at Low Gap renting solo and tandem sit-on-top kayaks, two-seat canoes and four- to six-person rafts, with shuttles, yurts, cabins and campgrounds on the upper Buffalo.
seasonal_notes: Closed as of August 2026 due to low water; the operator's site states it reopens 1 March 2027.
